description:
You are a Technical SEO auditing a legacy site. Configure Screaming Frog to perform a Source Code Search to identify pages still using the deprecated <meta name="keywords"> tag. 

STEPS:
1. Open Configuration > Custom > Search.
2. Add a new search rule to find the text '<meta name="keywords"'.
3. CRITICAL: Change the search scope from 'Page Text' to 'HTML' (or 'Source' depending on version) to ensure it checks the code, not just visible text.
4. Crawl 'https://crawler-test.com/'.
5. Wait for the crawl to finish.
6. Export the Custom Search report to '~/Documents/SEO/exports/meta_keywords_audit.csv'.

SUCCESS CRITERIA: The exported CSV must contain at least one URL where the tag was found (Count > 0).
